# mtncloud_key_pair (Data Source)

Provides an MTN Cloud key pair data source: looks up an SSH key pair by name or ID.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "mtncloud_key_pair" "tf_example_key_pair" {
  name = "TF Example Key Pair"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `id` (Number) The ID of the key pair
- `name` (String) The name of the integration
- `publickey` (String) PublicKey of the KeyPair
